skill_name: Describe the different types of professional opportunities available in a given industry.
workflow: The graphic design industry offers a variety of professional opportunities, such as graphic designers, concept designers, layout designers, production designers, and multimedia designers. Graphic designers create visuals to communicate messages, such as logos, infographics, posters, and web designs. Concept designers are responsible for showing an idea through design, form, and function. Layout designers create page layouts and work with typography, images, and diagrams.
